description: Defines a template class ScopedTypeRef for managing ownership of reference-counted types, patterned after std::unique_ptr, with customizable traits for retain/release semantics, specifically for macOS types.

classes.name: ScopedTypeRef
classes.description: A smart pointer template managing reference-counted types with customizable retain/release traits.

methods.name: InitializeInto
methods.description: Prepares the object for initialization with a create function, returning a pointer to the internal object.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Replaces the managed object, optionally retaining the new object and releasing the old one.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assigns from another ScopedTypeRef, retaining the new object.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the managed objects between two ScopedTypeRef instances.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases ownership of the managed object without releasing it.
